marks.gloss_en: and if not, let one bring three kefizei of Persian onions, boil them in wine and give it to her to drink
and if not, dig seven pits, burn orla vine shoots in them, and with a cup of wine in her hand move her from pit to pit
ת"ל ובארצכם לא תעשו -- בכם לא תעשו (kind svara stands in: no kind names a verse derivation)
דאמר ר' יוחנן: הרוצה שיסרס תרנגול יטול כרבלתו ומסתרס מאליו -- indirect castration is allowed
והאמר רב אשי: רמות רוחא הוא דנקיטא ליה -- [the comb's removal does not castrate it:] it is the rooster's haughtiness [that is lost], so the case proves nothing
ומי שרי? והתניא: מניין לסירוס באדם שהוא אסור -- is it permitted [to cause sterility]? The baraita forbids castrating a man
הני מילי היכא דקא מיכוין, הכא מעצמו הוא -- (abandoned: its proof deflected by Rav Ashi, the stam turns with אלא)
אלא בסריס -- (felled by R' Yochanan's מסרס אחר מסרס חייב)
the baraita: castration of a man is forbidden
והאמר ר' חייא בר אבא אמר ר' יוחנן: ... מסרס אחר מסרס חייב -- sterilising one already castrated is still liable (kind svara under protest: no kind names והאמר)
and if not, let one bring the head of a salted shibuta, boil it in beer and drink it
and if not, three kefizei each of Persian dates, dripping wax and red aloe, boiled in beer, and let him drink
a certain Arab who was ill with it said to the gardener: take my cloak and give me a row of leeks; he gave it to him and he ate it
